        'family_visible': family.first.is_visible(),

    page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    print('mobile_closed', {

        'body_visible': body.is_visible(),
        'family_visible': family.first.is_visible(),

    context.set_viewport_size({'width': 1440, 'height': 900})
    page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    print('desktop_after_resize', {
